approval_statement: Ben’s hard hat logo is good, lets use its location for the other kids
coordinate_note: Recorded boxes use Ben original 1536x1024 reference coordinates; multiply by two for approved 3072x2048 sheet. These are reference-image coordinates, not reusable screen coordinates on other children.
transfer_rules: Match Ben approved location relative to the front shell panel, front centerline and top of brim band.
Preserve the relative size and visible brim clearance shown in Ben; scale with the helmet, not the page.
Keep the exact locked badge PNG. Never regenerate or redraw it.
Front centerline follows helmet/nose direction. Project perspective and natural occlusion without changing the anchored location.
Retain each child assigned helmet style and color.
Retain accepted job sticker placements and sizes, including Leo P2.
The 3D guide must be fitted to this approved visual reference. It cannot override it.
Ben is unchanged. Leo P1-P4 are not approved logo masters.
limits: This locks a visual placement standard, not new physical millimeter dimensions or a verified 3D surface. Other children must be checked against Ben after application.
